name: projectx-40-primitives
description: Comprehensive specification of the 40 Orthogonal Functional Primitives across 8 Core Domains for ProjectX edge SaaS architecture.

primitives.name: Core Authentication
primitives.summary: Passkeys (WebAuthn), Argon2/PBKDF2 passwords, magic links, session tokens, MFA (TOTP).

primitives.name: Multi-Tenant Hierarchy
primitives.summary: Organizations, workspaces, team boundaries, cross-workspace switching, tenant isolation.

primitives.name: RBAC & ABAC Policy Engine
primitives.summary: Role-based and attribute-based access control, permission matrices, inheritance, dynamic capability checks.

primitives.name: Identity Federation & Enterprise SSO
primitives.summary: SAML 2.0, OIDC, directory sync (SCIM), social logins (Google, GitHub, Microsoft, Apple).

primitives.name: User Profile & Preferences
primitives.summary: Avatar pipelines, locales, timezones, themes (dark/light), communication preferences.

primitives.name: Ledger & Credit Wallet
primitives.summary: Double-entry append-only balance accounting, atomic deductions, overdraft protection.

primitives.name: Subscription & Plan Entitlements
primitives.summary: Tier definitions (Free, Pro, Enterprise), feature gating, subscription lifecycles, upgrades, proration.

primitives.name: Metered Usage & Event Ingestion
primitives.summary: High-throughput event counters (API calls, storage GB, compute seconds), aggregation windows, overage billing.

primitives.name: Multi-Gateway Checkout & Taxes
primitives.summary: Checkout sessions (Stripe, LemonSqueezy, Cashfree, Paddle), VAT/sales tax automation, invoice PDF generation.

primitives.name: Marketplace Splits & Payouts
primitives.summary: Two-sided platform fees, creator revenue shares, escrow holds, merchant payouts via Stripe Connect / Wise.

primitives.name: Dynamic Entity CRUD
primitives.summary: Generic relational data models, schema migrations, tenant-isolated queries, automated REST endpoints.

primitives.name: Binary Asset Pipeline
primitives.summary: Chunked uploads to R2, presigned upload URLs, CDN delivery, image metadata extraction.

primitives.name: Spreadsheet & Tabular Engine
primitives.summary: CSV/XLSX bulk ingestion, field mapping interfaces, batch validation, virtualized interactive data grids.

primitives.name: Document & PDF Generation
primitives.summary: HTML/Tailwind-to-PDF compilation, template variable hydration, watermarking, digital signing.

primitives.name: Full-Text & Faceted Search
primitives.summary: Inverted indexes (SQLite FTS5), tokenization, fuzzy search, typeahead autocomplete, faceted queries.

primitives.name: Vector Memory & Semantic Index
primitives.summary: Chunking, vector embedding generation, cosine similarity retrieval via Cloudflare Vectorize, RAG sync.

primitives.name: Workflow & DAG Engine
primitives.summary: Directed Acyclic Graph execution, branching/merging conditionals, stateful durable step execution.

primitives.name: Cron & Distributed Alarms
primitives.summary: Recurrence engines (RFC 5545 RRULE), scheduled future tasks, timezone-aware triggers, jitter control.

primitives.name: Background Job Queue & Dead-Letter Handling
primitives.summary: Asynchronous task offloading via Cloudflare Queues, concurrency rate-limits, priority queues, exponential retries.

primitives.name: Webhook Ingress & Egress Gateway
primitives.summary: Inbound payload verification (HMAC SHA-256), signature rotation, event broadcasting, failure retry policies.

primitives.name: Omnichannel Outbound Dispatcher
primitives.summary: Transactional delivery across Email (Resend/Workers Mail), SMS (Twilio), WhatsApp, Discord, Slack.

primitives.name: In-App Notification Center
primitives.summary: Bell icon feeds, unread badge counters, actionable notification items, web push notifications.

primitives.name: Real-Time Presence & State Sync
primitives.summary: WebSocket / SSE channels via Durable Objects, online/offline status, viewing pills, live cursor tracking.

primitives.name: Contextual Threaded Discussions
primitives.summary: Nested comment threads attached to arbitrary entity IDs, @mentions, rich markdown rendering, resolution flows.

primitives.name: Live Chat & Support Messenger
primitives.summary: In-app visitor widget, agent conversation inbox, canned replies, ticket escalation.

primitives.name: LLM Gateway & Prompt Router
primitives.summary: Multi-provider fallback (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Workers AI), cost tracking, token streaming over HTTP SSE.

primitives.name: Agent Sandbox & Tool Registry
primitives.summary: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server/client, structured JSON tool calling, sandboxed code/eval execution.

primitives.name: Document Parsing & Structured Extraction
primitives.summary: Multimodal OCR, PDF tabular extraction, schema-constrained JSON extraction from unstructured text.

primitives.name: Public API Key Infrastructure
primitives.summary: Cryptographic key generation (sk_live_...), SHA-256 hash storage, permission scopes, per-key rate limiting.

primitives.name: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server
primitives.summary: Third-party scoped app access, PKCE token exchanges, consent screens.

primitives.name: Outbound Developer Webhooks
primitives.summary: Customer endpoint subscriptions to platform events, signing secrets, delivery logs, payload replay.

primitives.name: Custom Domain & SSL Provisioning
primitives.summary: Vanity domain routing (client.com -> multi-tenant app), CNAME verification, Cloudflare SSL for SaaS.

primitives.name: Plugin / Scripting Sandbox
primitives.summary: Safe customer-written JavaScript / Lua extensions with isolated memory limits.

primitives.name: Audit Trail & Compliance Ledger
primitives.summary: Immutable append-only logs of administrative actions (actor, action, target, timestamp, IP) with compliance export.

primitives.name: Admin Console & User Impersonation
primitives.summary: Internal backoffice, Login-as-User session hijacking with audit trails, workspace overrides.

primitives.name: Edge Traffic Armor
primitives.summary: DDoS protection, WAF rules, IP allow/denylists, bot detection (Turnstile), rate-limit headers.

primitives.name: Data Privacy & GDPR Toolkit
primitives.summary: Export my Data ZIP generator, cascade account deletion (Right to be Forgotten), cookie consent.

primitives.name: Feature Flags & Progressive Rollouts
primitives.summary: Percentage-based user rollouts, canary deployments, environment overrides, instant kill-switches.

primitives.name: Product Analytics & Funnel Tracking
primitives.summary: Clickstream events, conversion funnel tracking, user retention cohorts, session analytics.

primitives.name: User Onboarding & Activation Tours
primitives.summary: Interactive checklist widgets, milestone progress bars, modal walkthroughs, feature discovery tooltips.
